Valentine.title: Nabu Metal Floor Lamp
Valentine.description: A tactile white finish on the striking Nabu floor lamp accentuates its accordion-like base. Its simple, yet artisan feel would make for a beautiful compliment to a casually sophisticated living room, home office, or bedroom.

Valentine.title: Watson Sconce
Valentine.description: Designed in a classic profile, the Watson sconce makes a versatile selection for any interior. The fixture embraces a bold contrast of materials, designed with a matte taupe steel shade affixed to a lustrous, antique brass steel wall mount. The sconce is fitted with an articulating arm that swivels to cast directional light. Certified for damp locations and intended for interior use.

Valentine.title: Leon Chandelier
Valentine.description: A cousin of the popular Eloise, the Leon features three tiers of white glazed glass plates, with a matching glass cover over the brass canopy. The classically elegant three-light chandelier is characterized by striking finishes and organic forms. The steel frames features an antique brass finish, beautifully contrasting the oyster-like forms of the glass plates, each with its own unique finish. Certified for damp locations and intended for interior use. finish will vary.

Valentine.title: Verre de Mer Small Chandelier
Valentine.description: The Verre de Mer Small Chandelier has a cascading shade made of sand-blasted glass that was hand-cut from recycled bottles to resemble seaglass. Each piece of this sustainable material is attached to the frame by hand, the wires wrapping around each requiring patience and precision to affix. The round metal frame, in a contemporary gold finish, holds four layers of very pale green glass that are illuminated by a single light.
